$sources: EN 1998-1 Sec 4.2.5, Table 4.3 (importance classes) and 4.2.5(5) (γI recommended values)
EN 1991-1-4: no importance factor on the wind (windImportance 1.0)
source: EN 1998-1 Sec 4.2.5, Table 4.3: importance classes I-IV with γI = 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.4 (recommended, 4.2.5(5)); the wind has no importance factor in EN 1991-1-4 (1.0). The reliability differentiation of EN 1990 Annex B (KFI by consequence class) is not applied.

I.description: Importance class I: buildings of minor importance for public safety (agricultural buildings and the like)

II.description: Importance class II: ordinary buildings not in the other classes

III.description: Importance class III: buildings whose seismic resistance matters for the consequences of a collapse (schools, assembly halls, cultural institutions)

IV.description: Importance class IV: buildings vital for civil protection during earthquakes (hospitals, fire stations, power plants)
